body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one ally within 5 units. It gains +1 die on its next Basic Attack before your next turn.

surges.html: One affected ally gains +1 Defense against the next Action that targets it.
Choose one additional eligible ally to receive this card's instruction.

rider.title: ORDER — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority on an ally within 5 units: 1–3 move 1 unit; 4–5 move 2 units; 6+ move 2 units and become Rallied.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
